candidates.change_summary: Change the Put function to not update the balance, so the balance after Put remains zero despite msg.value.
Replace the unlock time assignment with a constant 0, so funds are always collectible immediately.
Delete the unlockTime update entirely, leaving the previous unlockTime unchanged.
Set unlockTime to block.timestamp regardless of the _unlockTime argument, so funds are always available after current block.
Change the require condition to always revert, preventing any collection.
Remove the balance deduction so the caller receives ETH but balance remains unchanged.
Change the ETH transfer amount to zero so balance decreases but no ETH is sent.
Change the unlock time condition to always pass by removing the timestamp check.
